_comment: Conductor trunk protection ruleset (GitHub Repository Ruleset API). The non-bypassable safety backstop for ADR-0003/0004: even if a client misbehaves, a lost lease race can never write a non-linear or unverified trunk. Apply with: gh api -X POST repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets --input ruleset.json. Set bypass_actors[].actor_id to the Conductor bot App's installation id.
name: conductor-trunk

bypass_actors._comment: The Conductor bot App is the sole privileged trunk writer. Replace actor_id with the App's installation id; actor_type Integration; bypass only via the merge pipeline.
